subject: Data removal - compact wipe request and evidence for Medilabs
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah@medilabs.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medilabs.com, dpo@medilabs.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Full compact wipe for Medilabs (prompts + outputs + logs)

Hi Markus,

We're escalating our earlier request to a full compact wipe for the tenant data associated with Medilabs (account id: MED-9983). Scope per our internal policy: all prompt inputs, model outputs, and ingestion/serving logs going back to account creation (June 2024). We're primarily concerned about traces in prompt-output logs, KV-cache dumps, and any short-term traces in the serving runtime.

Attached is the signed deletion instruction from our DPO. Could you confirm the process and provide a timeline and evidence artifacts once complete? Our legal team is on copy.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Data Protection Officer
Medilabs

[Attachment: medilabs-deletion-request.pdf (application/pdf, 78 KB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah@medilabs.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full compact wipe for Medilabs (prompts + outputs + logs)

Thanks Sarah — received and looping in ops and security to run the compact wipe playbook. High level plan below; please confirm if this aligns with Medilabs' scope: 1) Isolate tenant traffic to prevent writes during sweep; 2) Run KV-cache and prompt-output purge jobs across serving clusters; 3) Expunge short-term runtime traces (ephemeral logs) and rotate model-level cache keys; 4) Collect evidence bundle (hash manifest + runbook + timestamps) and shared secure link; 5) Provide signed attestation from our SOC/compliance team.

Marissa/neha/karthik — urgent please: create OPS ticket, schedule maintenance window (we aim for 10/14 or 10/15 morning PST), and create an evidence tarball with checksums. Also flag whether any vendor copies (backup snapshots) contain relevant artifacts and the proposed retention-zeroing timeline.

I will communicate the timeline back to Medilabs once we have the ticket and ETA.

- Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

[Note: internal plan reference: Redwood Compact Wipe Playbook v2.1]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah@medilabs.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full compact wipe for Medilabs (prompts + outputs + logs)

Markus / team — OPS update and runbook summary.

Ticket: OPS-4821 (scheduled run: 2026-10-15 02:00-04:30 UTC / 2026-10-15 19:00-21:30 PDT maintenance window).
Steps performed (high level):
- Scoped tenant resources (tenant id MED-9983) and disabled write routes to serving pools.
- Executed prompt-output purge job (hash-based deletion) across shards: removed ~1.2M prompt-output pairs.
- Cleared KV-cache and rotated cache keys to invalidate short-term in-memory traces.
- Purged ephemeral runtime logs from serving hosts and redacted any indexes referencing customer identifiers.
- Verified snapshot retention: ran snapshot-scan and queued related backups for targeted retention-zeroing; backups will be processed in the next backup window (see note).

Evidence artifacts (attached to ops ticket and included in evidence bundle): sweep-evidence-20261015.tar.gz (contains manifest.txt, checksums.sha256, runbook-execution.log).

Caveats: We found two S3 snapshots (s3://redwood-backups/cluster-b/2026-09-27) that contained truncated prompt-output fragments; backup retention-zeroing requires a secondary job and a scheduled window (estimated completion: 2026-10-20). We will include that as part of the full attestation timeline.

Marissa will coordinate the attestation and legal review.

- Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: sweep-evidence-20261015.tar.gz (application/gzip, 4.2 MB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@medilabs.com>, legal@medilabs.com

Subject: Compact wipe confirmation + evidence delivery for Medilabs (OPS-4821)

Sarah / Medilabs legal team —

Thank you for your patience. Per the run executed on 2026-10-15 under ticket OPS-4821, Redwood has completed the compact wipe workflow for tenant MED-9983 as scoped in your request. What we completed today: prompt/output purge across serving shards, KV-cache invalidation, ephemeral runtime log removal, and manifest generation.

Outstanding item: final backup retention-zeroing for the two identified snapshots (see Karthik's note). That secondary job is scheduled and expected to complete by 2026-10-20. We will issue a follow-up attestation for full completion of backup zeroing.
